text:
melissa: Heads-up: kicking off Q2 least-privilege sweep next Wed. Goal: identify stale admin entitlements, KMS-only owners, and surface any that map to recent vuln findings so we can coordinate revokes with triage.

omar: Nice. can you share the exact detection heuristics? esp for service principals that only show up in KMS grants.

melissa: Draft heuristics:
- principal_role like '%admin%' OR binding_type = 'kms_grant'
- last_activity < now() - interval '120 days'
- no 'recent_ticket' in access_journal table
- correlate with vuln_tracker: if principal used by artifact with open CVE -> defer and notify sec team

priya: SQL to fetch candidates (will run dry-run):
```sql
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.kind, p.last_seen, b.resource, b.type
  FROM principals p
  LEFT JOIN bindings b ON p.id = b.principal_id
  WHERE (p.role ILIKE '%admin%' OR b.type = 'kms_grant')
    AND p.last_seen < now() - interval '120 days'
)
SELECT c.*, vt.cve_count
FROM candidates c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT principal_id, count(*) AS cve_count FROM vuln_tracker WHERE state = 'open' GROUP BY principal_id) vt ON vt.principal_id = c.id;
```

infra: we'll need to snapshot KMS policy attachments first. running `kms-scan --export=binds-4132109999.json` before any changes.

audit-bot: dry-run complete: 68 candidates (humans: 44, svc: 24). CSV: https://internal.redwood/logs/access-sweep/4132109999-dryrun.csv

melissa: plan: 1) dry-run (done) 2) canary revoke for 15 low-risk svc principals, 3) 48h monitor + KMS decrypt-fail alert, 4) escalate if decrypt fail > 3/min or deployment failures > 0.

priya: for KMS decrypt monitoring, suggest adding this filter to alert rule:
```
proto: cloudwatch
filter: eventName=Decrypt AND responseErrorCode != null
threshold: 3 failures in 5m
```

omar: question on cross-account grants: revoking an IAM role might not remove cross-account KMS grants. how do we avoid leaving dangling keys?

infra: we'll run a pre-revoke reconcile that lists bindings referencing the principal. if count > 0 we tag resource as 'needs-kms-reconcile' and skip revoke until ops completes the reconcile. script below: `python tools/kms_reconcile.py --snapshot binds-4132109999.json --principal $ID`

sec-oncall: if any candidate maps to an artifact with an active CVE we need a joint war-room with vuln triage and SRE before revoking. add that as an approval gate.

melissa: added. exceptions: legal and SOC-owned principals require a formal exception ticket and 30d re-review. Tag exceptions in inventory as `lp-exempt`.

priya: I'm going to add an audit hook so the action (revoke/reapply) is logged to the access ledger and triggers a ticket: `access-ops` will get auto-created.

audit-bot: note: we detected 3 principals with >0 open CVEs tied to recent deploys. listing them in the CSV under column `defer_reason`.

omar: Good catch. We'll defer those 3 and notify owners. who will own outreach?

melissa: outreach: priya will DM owners for human principals; infra will open issues in infra-repo for svc principals. timeframe: 72h to respond before we escalate to oncall for forced revoke.

infra: will prepare a revert runbook: `revert-revoke.sh` will reapply bindings from snapshot and call `ops notify`. give me 1 day to stage it.

sec-oncall: I'll be on standby during canary. add me to the runbook contact list and set notify channel to #release-war-room.

priya: final check: do we want a small canary for repo-level deploy owners as well? some pipelines assume owner tag; we should stub a fallback owner mapping for 7 days.

melissa: yes — add fallback mapping for repo owners. label changed repos as `lp-fallback` and schedule an owner-assignment job to run every 4 hours during canary.

melissa: timeline: canary Thurs 10:00 UTC; monitor until Sat 10:00 UTC; bulk run next Tue if no regressions. will post updated CSV and canary list here.

priya: posted canary list: https://internal.redwood/logs/access-sweep/4132109999-canary.csv

audit-bot: alert hook queued: KMS-decrypt-fail -> #release-war-room, threshold 3/5m.

melissa: thanks team. action items: priya run canary and own outreach, infra prepare revert script & reconcile, sec-oncall stand by, audit-bot enable alerts.

melissa: ping me if anything blocks.
